svg.title: Asset Manager Pro, version 2.0.0: a local AI asset catalog for designers on Windows. Semantic search, PSD/AI/SVG/RAW/video indexing, reviewed AI tags, duplicate and version detection, undoable batch rename, license audit and moodboards. Tested on a 108k-asset catalog; opens in 2.4 s; fully offline AI.
svg.text: A local AI asset catalog for designers.

g.text: Search by meaning: “blue logo mockups kind:psd”
Reads PSD, AI/EPS, SVG, RAW, HEIC, video and XMP
AI tag suggestions you review before anything is saved
Finds duplicates and logo_v1 → logo_final version chains
Batch rename with dry-run preview and one-click undo
License audit, moodboards and resource-pack imports
